annotations.title: What to fix on one website

description: For one of the organization's verified websites: the latest analysis and its findings (problems found in its search and visitor data), ranked by the website's goal when it has one, each with its estimated effect on that goal, its evidence numbers, likely causes and what to try. Minor findings are marked. Findings are computed by fixed rules, never by a model. A website that is not this organization's answers not found. It changes nothing.
name: webops_findings
title: What to fix on one website
